note: HOMING KNOB — config:{homing:"empty_first"} OPT-IN (config-gated flexibility, arrangement-sole-backbone Phase C; the operator's 'fill BOTH screens' policy, memory: wm-tiling-target-model). SAME scene as sync-homing-focus-piles-on-occupied (two displays; an empty tree; TWO tileable newcomers whose observed frames BOTH geometrically land on D1), but with homing flipped to "empty_first". The newcomers are paired with the empty displays id-sorted: w1 -> D1 (the first empty), w2 -> D2 (the second empty) — so BOTH displays are filled (root -> [d:1 -> w:1, d:2 -> w:2]) instead of piling on D1. This is the OPT-IN behavior; the default "focus" (sync-homing-focus-piles-on-occupied / sync-homing-geometric-not-empty-display) keeps the geometric pile byte-identical. The knob is a PURE rewrite of the window->display home map (autotile::_rehome_to_empty) — ZERO frame/clamp/split math; ensure_scaffold mounts the now-occupied D2 and adopt_newcomers seeds each.
